newsitem.title: JAPAN: Canon develops single-chip LSI circuit for cameras.
newsitem.headline: Canon develops single-chip LSI circuit for cameras.

text.p: Canon Inc said on Tuesday it developed the world's first chip for digital video cameras that combines recording and playback signal processing circuits into a single large-scale integrated (LSI) circuit.
The new technology, which conforms with the global standard for digital video, allows multiple signal processing functions such as image reduction and expansion, Canon said in a statement.
The new chip paves the way for the development of smaller, energy-saving, higher quality cameras which can be easily connected to personal computers and other multimedia equipment, Canon said.
Canon said it intends to use the chip, which was developed in cooperation with Fujitsu Ltd, in future models of digital camcoders.
"The technology employed in the chip represents the highest level of performance ever attained in a digital video camera LSI circuit," Canon said.
